info.name: One Chembur CMS API
info.description:
Every route of the One Chembur real-estate CMS API.

**How to use**
1. Set the collection variables: `baseUrl` (local: http://localhost:5000, deployed: your Vercel site or Render URL), `adminEmail`, `adminPassword`.
2. Run **Auth > Login** first. The API sets an httpOnly cookie (`token`); Postman stores and sends it automatically for every later request.
3. Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). The create requests save ids into collection variables that the following requests use; each folder cleans up after itself.

**Notes**
- Public routes need no login. `/api/admin/*` needs the cookie (401 without it).
- Rate limits: login 10 attempts / 15 min, public enquiries 10 / hour (per IP).
- Errors are JSON: `{ success: false, message, errors? }` where `errors` maps field name to message.
- Uploads need Cloudinary configured on the server (otherwise 503).

item.name: Account
item.description: Change the admin password. The folder switches it to {{tempPassword}} and straight back, so run it as a whole (rate limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes). Sessions that existed before a change are signed out; the response sets a fresh cookie so this session continues.

exec: pm.test("Change password (wrong current password, 400): status 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: A wrong current password is a 400 with errors.currentPassword (not a 401), so a UI can show it on the field.

exec: pm.test("Change password (confirmation mismatch, 400): status 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: New password must be 10+ characters (max 72 bytes), different from the current one, and match confirmPassword.

exec: pm.test("Change password: status 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Verifies the current password, stores the new bcrypt hash and logs "Changed password" in the activity log (no password data). Returns a fresh session cookie.

exec: pm.test("Change password back: status 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Restores the original password so the rest of the collection keeps working.

item.name: Sign out
item.description: Run last: clears the session cookie.

exec: pm.test("Logout: status 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Clears the cookie.

exec: pm.test("Current user after logout (401): status 401", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
